textos.texto: Ana likes her city. In the city centre there is a big square with a park. Near the park there is a museum and a theatre. You can visit the museum on Sunday, because it is open. On Monday it is closed. There is also a library, and Ana studies there when she is not in her apartment. The hospital is far from her house, but the pharmacy is very near. There is a bank next to the post office, and a café on the street. Ana often has a coffee there with Laura. The station is not far from the city centre and the airport is far. There is a bridge and a stadium too. It is a nice place to live.

preguntas.enunciado: When can you visit the museum?
The library is next to the museum.
Where does Ana study when she is not in her apartment?
The airport is near the city centre.
